FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY holds above key MA20 support at 156.76 despite Japanese FX rate check.
Bond yield dynamics and BOJ policy divergence support USD strength, but intervention risk remains a key volatility driver.
Tactical entry initiated on dip toward 156.80 with tight stop-loss below 156.50.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds MA20 support amid BOJ divergence. Intervention risk requires disciplined tactical entries.
FX.comment: USD/JPY holds above MA20 support at 156.76, with RSI at 39.47 signaling healthy consolidation ahead of a potential breakout toward 157.20.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Price Below MA20 as Elevated Yields Cap Momentum
tldr_points: The S&P 500 trades 8.39 points below its MA20, creating a near-term bearish pivot.
Elevated yields and oil are the principal macro headwinds despite resilience in the index and selected momentum names.
A tactical short at 7650.50 targets 7600.00, with 7680.00 as the invalidation level.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 sits below its MA20 as elevated yields and oil support a tactical downside setup toward 7600.
STOCKS.comment: Price is below MA20 with sub-50 RSI, while elevated yields and oil create a tactical downside bias.
